Version.PreText: igbFinisher has been updated to version 2.0.0 with the following changes:
Version.PostText: Version 2.0.1 was released right after, which fixed the internal version number.

Change.Desc: Hex editing is now an internal process thanks to ak2yny, so XVI32 is no longer required.
Change.Desc_GH: Hex editing is now an internal process thanks to @ak2yny, so XVI32 is no longer required.

Change.Desc: Added new Alchemy-based texture recognition thanks to ak2yny, which allowed for a reduction in user input.
Change.Desc_GH: Added new Alchemy-based texture recognition thanks to @ak2yny, which allowed for a reduction in user input.

Change.Desc: Updated processing to allow automatic detection for other aspects, like mannequin pose names and cel shading.
Updated settings to allow the user to put a default, ask each run, or skip for all 4 character numbers and 2 paths.

Version.PreText: I updated igbFinisher to v2.1.0 a while back and forgot to update about it. The following was changed:
Version.PostText: I also just updated to version 2.1.1, which fixed some issues with paths.

Change.Desc: Several improvements:
Hex editing:
Now accounts for any possible geometry name that contains the number "12301."
Now accounts for any textures with the number "12301" in their name.
Untextured models are now supported.
Settings now requires full skin numbers rather than character numbers.
This allows for support for skin swaps or just specially-numbered skins.
Alchemy optimizations are now formatted to remove excess space and comments.
Bug fixes:
Fixed an issue with path collection that was removing unnecessary characters.
Fixed some issues with paths.

Version.PreText: igbFinisher has been updated to version 3.0.0 with the following updates:

Change.Desc: Improved overall program design for efficiency.
Added support for XML2 PSP skins.
Added support for power icons, comic covers, and loading screens.
Added a feature to track the last Alchemy reset date so that it doesn't have to be reset every time the program is run.
Added a feature to detect the destination path based on the input path.
Changed how character numbers are handled in the settings to allow better control for descriptions.
Added the ability to skip descriptions on assets.
Updated formats to line up with the latest version of the Marvel Mods GIMP Scripts.
Set up PS2 to always export to a separate folder, since many PS2 assets use a unique format.

Version.PreText: igbFinisher has been updated to version 3.1.0 with the following updates:

Change.Desc: Added support for AnimationProducer, which allows for skins to be built into default-style animation databases, removing the dummy animation and slightly reducing file size.
Added some additional hex editing to skins to more closely match default skin structure.
Improved handling of environment maps to address some detection issues.

Version.PreText: igbFinisher has been updated to v4.0.0 with lots of changes!

Change.Desc: The program is now called as an exe from the command line or a batch file.
Change.Desc_GH: The program is now called as an exe from the command line: `igbFinisher.exe (filename).igb`.

Change.Desc: You can now specify a custom settings file (if no settings file is specified, the default name is used).
[b][font=Courier New][color=#ba8bff]igbFinisher.exe (filename).igb -s path\to\settings.ini[/color][/font][/b]
[b][font=Courier New][color=#ba8bff]igbFinisher.exe (filename).igb --settings path\to\settings.ini[/color][/font][/b]
The program runs once and then closes rather than staying open, so this no longer freezes your file explorer window.
Settings have been revised for better control:
You can now specify paths for all games.
There are more options for names and numbers.
You can specify a different path for each game.
You can selectively control each console.
Many new settings are added to work with the new capabilities.
Error checking is much more simple and straightforward.

Console-specific texture folders are no longer needed! igbFinisher now only needs plain png files. The [url="https://marvelmods.com/forum/index.php/topic,11441.0.html"]Marvel Mods GIMP Scripts[/url] have been updated to account for this.
Change.Desc_GH: Console-specific texture folders are no longer needed! igbFinisher now only needs plain png files. The [Marvel Mods GIMP Scripts](https://github.com/EthanReed517/Marvel-Mods-Gimp-Scripts) have been updated to account for this.

Change.Desc: Textures are resized and texture formats are now converted with Alchemy optimizations using Alchemy 3.2 and Alchemy 5.
Alchemy 3.2 optimizations slightly reduce the file size of static models for last-gen consoles.
Added new Alchemy optimizations: generating collision and setting up advanced textures.
Improved error handling.
Improved overall process flow for speed and efficiency.
